Hi Lior Beres, could I ask you a follow up question about this please.
We had our first appointment to show the original documents and I received a B2 visa valid until February and an inter visa. I assumed I would be able to do the conversion, but now I just noticed a line on the guide that B2 can’t at all convert to an Israeli license… Not even if it has a validity of half a year and is in the context of the partner visa process?
Thanks so much!
